# Astronomical 0.2.38
## Thinking budgets from OpenAI clients
Chat clients that declare a thinking level through the standard OpenAI `reasoning_effort` field now get exactly that behavior. `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, and `high` map to enforced thinking-token budgets, so agents and apps that send effort levels instead of numeric budgets no longer have their request silently ignored. Explicit numeric budget spellings still take precedence, unknown labels are rejected with a clear error, and `off` or `none` disables the budget.
## Configurable SpecPrefill trailing window
The draft-assisted prompt-processing trailing window — the number of recent prompt tokens the target model always processes densely regardless of importance ranking — is now settable per model through `acceleration.speculative_prefill.mandatory_trailing_token_count`. The default of 512 is unchanged, so existing configurations behave exactly as before, and legacy configurations that already carried a different value now migrate cleanly instead of being refused.
## Crash fix in speculative prefill
Fixed a deterministic crash that could stop a request when speculative prefill retained decode route arrays that were never evaluated. Affected forwards now evaluate with the attribution they build with, and finalization evaluates before copying, so a straggler costs one bounded wait instead of the process.
## Lighter serving core
The learned expert-route predictor serving surface is retired, removing dead serving weight. Route observation capture, previous-token prefetch, and hot-expert warming all remain in place.
## Dependency refresh
reqwest updated to 0.13.5, unifying its base64 usage with the rest of the workspace.
Your models, prompt caches, and preferences carry over unchanged.
